- Document ImageMagick limitations with verification results (what cannot be set, tiling can).
- Update CHANGELOG count 17→2 and add a Fixed/Changed bullet.

# Issue #42 — Analysis / Context Document

Issue: #42 "Update YCbCr documentation: ReferenceBlackWhite scaling, remove
inaccurate test image, audit all test images"
Label: enhancement · Follow-up to #38
Branch: `feature/issue-42` from `main` @ `d934a81`
Scope: DOCS_AND_CODE

---

## 1. Acceptance criteria checklist (all 8)

| # | Criterion | How this change satisfies it |
|---|-----------|------------------------------|
| 1 | `YCBCR_SUPPORT.md` includes the full ReferenceBlackWhite scaling formula and "code" terminology. | Expand the current weak "Reference black/white" H3 section (lines 64–74) with the full scaling formula and consistent use of the word "code" (and "codes") for YCbCr sample values. Replace the vague "allowing scaling of the YCbCr codes into the full data range" prose with the explicit equations. |
| 2 | `ycbcr-custom-refbw.tif` and its reference PPM are removed from disk and script. | `tests/ycbcr_images/ycbcr-custom-refbw.tif` and `tests/ycbcr_images/ycbcr-custom-refbw.ppm` deleted; the `custom-refbw` CASE tuple (generate_ycbcr.py lines 46–47) removed. Audit proved the fixture never actually carried ReferenceBlackWhite (tag 532 absent), so its name was false. |
| 3 | All remaining test images are verified against their claimed attributes via TIFF tag inspection. | Independently parsed all 17 TIFFs with a hand-written struct parser (`/tmp/opencode/tiffparse.py`), cross-checked against PIL 13.0.0 (exiftool/tiffinfo/tifffile unavailable). Final set of 2 images re-verified after regen (details in §3). |
| 4 | Any test image that doesn't match its claims is either fixed or removed with documented reason. | 1 accurate image kept; 1 (tiled) fixed by regeneration; 15 inaccurate images removed with a documented reason in YCBCR_SUPPORT.md (subsampling not settable, positioning/coefficients/RefBW/planar not settable, odd-dimension cases only valid with subsampling). |
| 5 | ImageMagick limitations are documented in `YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`. | New H2 `## ImageMagick limitations` inserted after `## Generating the test images` (ends line 116) and before `## Test image matrix` (line 118). Records what Magick cannot set and what it can (tiling), with verification results. |
| 6 | `ycbcr-custom-coeffs.tif` is verified or removed. | Verified then removed: tag YCbCrCoefficients (529) absent in every file including this one; default BT.601 coefficients implied, so the "custom-coeffs" claim was false. Its PPM and CASE tuple are removed too. |
| 7 | `generate_ycbcr.py` is updated to match the final set of test images. | CASES list reduced from 17 tuples (lines 34–54) to exactly the 2 fixtures that survive; tiled case regenerated at full 64x48 using `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` and renamed `ycbcr-tiled`. |
| 8 | `CHANGELOG.md` updated if image count changes. | Count changes 17 → 2. Update CHANGELOG.md line 32 ("17 generated YCbCr test images under tests/ycbcr_images/") to "2", and add a Fixed/Changed bullet describing the audit, removals, and documentation fixes. |

---

## 2. Primary files and rationale

**`tests/YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`** (159 lines) — the main documentation surface.
Structure: H1; H2 sections Scope, Tag definitions, Conversion formulas (H3:
Forward, Reverse, Reference black/white), Subsampling, Positioning, Minimum
requirements, Generating the test images, Test image matrix (3 sub-tables),
Ground-truth reference images.
- Weak RefBW section at lines 64–74: says the tag supplies reference
  black/white defining headroom/footroom and "allowing scaling of the YCbCr
  codes into the full data range"; states defaults Y 0/255, Cb/Cr 128/255.
  No formula and no "code" terminology as a defined concept. This is the
  target of criterion 1.
- Matrix at lines 128–154: 9 subsampling rows (1x1..4x4), 5 variant rows
  (cosited, custom-coeffs line 143, custom-refbw line 144, planar-2x2,
  tiled-2x2), 3 odd rows = 17 images. All rows except the 1x1/default row
  are inaccurate and must be removed/relabelled; custom-coeffs and
  custom-refbw rows go away entirely.
- No existing ImageMagick limitations section — must be created (criterion 5).
- Style to follow: ATX headings, ~80-column wrapping, GFM pipe tables,
  backticks for tags/files.

**`tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py`** — fixture generator.
- 17 `CASES` tuples at lines 34–54. Fields `(positioning, coeffs, refbw,
  planar, bits)` are unpacked in `main()` (line 94) but NEVER used — ImageMagick
  never receives them. This is the root cause of the inaccurate fixtures.
- Subsampling cases use `-resize ceil(w/hs)xceil(h/vs)!`, which physically
  SHRINKS the image instead of writing the `YCbCrSubSampling` tag. Ground-truth
  PPM is written from the original RGB `pixels`, so the PPM dimensions no
  longer match the TIFF for subsampled cases.
- Must be rewritten to generate only the 2 accurate fixtures, using
  `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` for the tiled image, and dropping the
  unused fields.

**`CHANGELOG.md`** — Keep a Changelog format, past-tense bullets.
- Line 32 holds the only explicit image count in the repo: "17 generated YCbCr
  test images under tests/ycbcr_images/". Update to 2 and add a Fixed/Changed
  bullet. No counts exist in YCBCR_SUPPORT.md, TEST_IMAGES.md, or README.md.

**`tests/ycbcr_images/ycbcr-custom-refbw.tif`** + **`.ppm`** — delete (criterion 2).
**`tests/ycbcr_images/ycbcr-custom-coeffs.tif`** + **`.ppm`** — delete (criterion 6).

**Fixtures to delete (15 TIFFs + their 15 PPMs):** all subsampling cases
(1x2, 1x4, 2x1, 2x2, 2x4, 4x1, 4x2, 4x4), cosited, custom-coeffs,
custom-refbw, planar-2x2, odd-2x1, odd-2x2, odd-4x4 (and the tiled-2x2
case replaced by the fixed `ycbcr-tiled`). Actual filenames should be read
from the generator CASES list before deletion.

**Keep unchanged:** `ycbcr-1x1.tif` + `.ppm` (the only accurate fixture).

**No other references:** zero references to custom-refbw/custom-coeffs outside
YCBCR_SUPPORT.md lines 143–144 and generate_ycbcr.py lines 46–47. No C++,
CMake, CI, or shell references. Deleting fixtures breaks nothing at build/test
time.

---

## 3. Change approach (decision to implement)

### Independent TIFF tag audit (completed)
- All 17 files: little-endian classic TIFF, identical tag set
  `{256,257,258,259,262,266,273,274,277,278,279,284,297,318,319,530}`.
  BitsPerSample=[8,8,8], Compression=1, PhotometricInterpretation=6,
  SamplesPerPixel=3, PlanarConfig=1, YCbCrSubSampling=[1,1].
  YCbCrCoefficients (529), YCbCrPositioning (531), ReferenceBlackWhite (532),
  TileWidth/Length (322/323) are ALL ABSENT in every file.
- 16 of 17 images FAIL their claims. Only `ycbcr-1x1.tif` (64x48, 1x1, all
  defaults) PASSES.
- Subsampled images are physically downscaled (e.g. 2x2 is 32x24, 4x4 is
  16x12, odd-2x2 is 31x24 vs claimed 61x47) with no subsampling tag.
- `custom-refbw.tif`: no tag 532; same IFD/tags as 1x1; differs only in 9216
  pixel bytes — NOT byte-identical to 1x1 (SHA256 19078a9f... vs 70ffdf2e...;
  metadata identical, pixel data differs). The issue's "inaccurate test image"
  concern is about the false RefBW claim, not byte identity.
- `custom-coeffs.tif`: no tag 529 (BT.601 default implied).
- `cosited.tif`: no tag 531. `planar-2x2.tif`: PlanarConfig=1.
  `tiled-2x2.tif`: no tile tags, uses RowsPerStrip=24.

### Feasibility experiments (magick 7.1.2-35, /tmp/opencode)
- `-sampling-factor 2x2` does NOT write YCbCrSubSampling (stays [1,1]) and
  keeps full dimensions → subsampling NOT settable.
- `-define tiff:YCbCrPositioning=2`, `-set tiff:YCbCrPositioning 2`,
  `-define tiff:YCbCrCoefficients=...`, `-define tiff:ReferenceBlackWhite=...`,
  `-interlace Plane`, `-define tiff:planar-configuration=separate` — NONE set
  the respective tags.
- `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` DOES write TileWidth=64/TileLength=48 and
  TileOffsets/TileByteCounts (no RowsPerStrip) → TILING IS settable and
  verified.

### Final decision
1. **Keep** `ycbcr-1x1.tif` (+ `.ppm`) unchanged — the only accurate fixture.
2. **Fix** the tiled case: regenerate at full 64x48 with
   `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48`, rename to `ycbcr-tiled.tif` (+
   `ycbcr-tiled.ppm`), relabel in the matrix as 1x1 / default / tiled. Tiling
   is the only variant attribute ImageMagick can truly set.
3. **Remove** the other 15 TIFFs and their 15 PPMs, documenting each reason:
   - subsampling not settable (`-resize` shrank images instead of tagging),
   - positioning / coefficients / ReferenceBlackWhite / planar not settable,
   - odd-dimension cases only valid together with real subsampling.
   Final fixture set = 2 images.
4. **Document** ImageMagick limitations in YCBCR_SUPPORT.md with verification
   results (what cannot be set; tiling can).
5. **Update** CHANGELOG.md count 17 → 2 and add a Fixed/Changed bullet.

---

## 4. Risks

- **RefBW formula accuracy:** must present the full, correct scaling equation.
  The conventional form maps code `C` to full-range `V` using reference black
  `Rblack` and reference white `Rwhite`:
  `V = (C - Rblack) * (MAX - MIN) / (Rwhite - Rblack) + MIN`, with defaults
  Y: 0/255, Cb/Cr: 128/255. Verify against the repo's forward/reverse formulas
  (H3 sections) and the TIFF 6.0 spec before finalizing, to avoid contradicting
  the library implementation.
- **No automated verification of tags in repo:** the audit relied on external
  ad-hoc tooling; ensure the regen command is re-run and re-verified after the
  final generator edit (the audit script `/tmp/opencode/tiffparse.py` is in
  temp storage, not the repo).
- **Generator still parses unused fields:** if any tuple fields remain, avoid
  leaving dead unpacking; align the CASES structure with what is actually
  emitted.
- **PPM/TIFF dimension mismatch:** ensure the kept/fixed PPMs match their TIFFs
  (both 64x48). The fixed tiled TIFF must be 64x48, not downscaled.
- **Test image count references:** confirm no other file (README, TEST_IMAGES,
  docs) states 17; research found none, but re-check after edits.
- **CI/build breakage:** low risk — no source/CI references fixtures — but run
  the standard validation anyway.

### Validation commands (no AGENTS.md in repo; CI runs the same three steps)
- Build: `./build.sh` (cmake --preset + cmake --build --preset, default
  preset `gcc-linux-release`)
- Test: `./run_test.sh` (ctest --preset ... --output-on-failure --rerun-failed)
- Fixture regen: `python3 tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py`

---

## 5. Docs impact

- `tests/YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`:
  - Rewrite "Reference black/white" H3 (lines 64–74) with full scaling formula
    and "code" terminology.
  - Add new H2 `## ImageMagick limitations` between "Generating the test
    images" (ends line 116) and "Test image matrix" (line 118).
  - Rebuild "Test image matrix" (lines 128–154) to 2 accurate rows:
    - `ycbcr-1x1.tif` — 64x48, subsampling 1x1, default coefficients,
      default ReferenceBlackWhite, centered positioning, chunky/contig,
      stripped. Ground-truth `ycbcr-1x1.ppm`.
    - `ycbcr-tiled.tif` — 64x48, subsampling 1x1, all defaults, tiled
      (TileWidth/Length 64x48). Ground-truth `ycbcr-tiled.ppm`.
  - Update "Generating the test images" to describe the regen command and the
    fact that only settable attributes are emitted.
  - Possibly trim "Minimum requirements"/other sections if they reference
    removed fixtures; verify no dangling file mentions.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: line 32 count 17 → 2; add a past-tense Fixed/Changed bullet
  summarizing the audit, fixture removals, tiled fix, and documentation
  improvements.
- No counts or fixture lists in `TEST_IMAGES.md` / `README.md` (verified) — no
  changes expected there, but confirm during implementation.

| 4 | Any test image that doesn't match its claims is either fixed or removed with documented reason. | 1 accurate image kept; 1 (tiled) fixed by regeneration; 15 inaccurate images removed with a documented reason in YCBCR_SUPPORT.md (subsampling not settable, positioning/coefficients/RefBW/planar not settable, odd-dimension cases only valid with subsampling). |
| 5 | ImageMagick limitations are documented in `YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`. | New H2 `## ImageMagick limitations` inserted after `## Generating the test images` (ends line 116) and before `## Test image matrix` (line 118). Records what Magick cannot set and what it can (tiling), with verification results. |
| 6 | `ycbcr-custom-coeffs.tif` is verified or removed. | Verified then removed: tag YCbCrCoefficients (529) absent in every file including this one; default BT.601 coefficients implied, so the "custom-coeffs" claim was false. Its PPM and CASE tuple are removed too. |
| 7 | `generate_ycbcr.py` is updated to match the final set of test images. | CASES list reduced from 17 tuples (lines 34–54) to exactly the 2 fixtures that survive; tiled case regenerated at full 64x48 using `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` and renamed `ycbcr-tiled`. |
| 8 | `CHANGELOG.md` updated if image count changes. | Count changes 17 → 2. Update CHANGELOG.md line 32 ("17 generated YCbCr test images under tests/ycbcr_images/") to "2", and add a Fixed/Changed bullet describing the audit, removals, and documentation fixes. |

---

## 2. Primary files and rationale

**`tests/YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`** (159 lines) — the main documentation surface.
Structure: H1; H2 sections Scope, Tag definitions, Conversion formulas (H3:
Forward, Reverse, Reference black/white), Subsampling, Positioning, Minimum
requirements, Generating the test images, Test image matrix (3 sub-tables),
Ground-truth reference images.
- Weak RefBW section at lines 64–74: says the tag supplies reference
  black/white defining headroom/footroom and "allowing scaling of the YCbCr
  codes into the full data range"; states defaults Y 0/255, Cb/Cr 128/255.
  No formula and no "code" terminology as a defined concept. This is the
  target of criterion 1.
- Matrix at lines 128–154: 9 subsampling rows (1x1..4x4), 5 variant rows
  (cosited, custom-coeffs line 143, custom-refbw line 144, planar-2x2,
  tiled-2x2), 3 odd rows = 17 images. All rows except the 1x1/default row
  are inaccurate and must be removed/relabelled; custom-coeffs and
  custom-refbw rows go away entirely.
- No existing ImageMagick limitations section — must be created (criterion 5).
- Style to follow: ATX headings, ~80-column wrapping, GFM pipe tables,
  backticks for tags/files.

**`tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py`** — fixture generator.
- 17 `CASES` tuples at lines 34–54. Fields `(positioning, coeffs, refbw,
  planar, bits)` are unpacked in `main()` (line 94) but NEVER used — ImageMagick
  never receives them. This is the root cause of the inaccurate fixtures.
- Subsampling cases use `-resize ceil(w/hs)xceil(h/vs)!`, which physically
  SHRINKS the image instead of writing the `YCbCrSubSampling` tag. Ground-truth
  PPM is written from the original RGB `pixels`, so the PPM dimensions no
  longer match the TIFF for subsampled cases.
- Must be rewritten to generate only the 2 accurate fixtures, using
  `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` for the tiled image, and dropping the
  unused fields.

**`CHANGELOG.md`** — Keep a Changelog format, past-tense bullets.
- Line 32 holds the only explicit image count in the repo: "17 generated YCbCr
  test images under tests/ycbcr_images/". Update to 2 and add a Fixed/Changed
  bullet. No counts exist in YCBCR_SUPPORT.md, TEST_IMAGES.md, or README.md.

**`tests/ycbcr_images/ycbcr-custom-refbw.tif`** + **`.ppm`** — delete (criterion 2).
**`tests/ycbcr_images/ycbcr-custom-coeffs.tif`** + **`.ppm`** — delete (criterion 6).

**Fixtures to delete (15 TIFFs + their 15 PPMs):** all subsampling cases
(1x2, 1x4, 2x1, 2x2, 2x4, 4x1, 4x2, 4x4), cosited, custom-coeffs,
custom-refbw, planar-2x2, odd-2x1, odd-2x2, odd-4x4 (and the tiled-2x2
case replaced by the fixed `ycbcr-tiled`). Actual filenames should be read
from the generator CASES list before deletion.

**Keep unchanged:** `ycbcr-1x1.tif` + `.ppm` (the only accurate fixture).

**No other references:** zero references to custom-refbw/custom-coeffs outside
YCBCR_SUPPORT.md lines 143–144 and generate_ycbcr.py lines 46–47. No C++,
CMake, CI, or shell references. Deleting fixtures breaks nothing at build/test
time.

---

## 3. Change approach (decision to implement)

### Independent TIFF tag audit (completed)
- All 17 files: little-endian classic TIFF, identical tag set
  `{256,257,258,259,262,266,273,274,277,278,279,284,297,318,319,530}`.
  BitsPerSample=[8,8,8], Compression=1, PhotometricInterpretation=6,
  SamplesPerPixel=3, PlanarConfig=1, YCbCrSubSampling=[1,1].
  YCbCrCoefficients (529), YCbCrPositioning (531), ReferenceBlackWhite (532),
  TileWidth/Length (322/323) are ALL ABSENT in every file.
- 16 of 17 images FAIL their claims. Only `ycbcr-1x1.tif` (64x48, 1x1, all
  defaults) PASSES.
- Subsampled images are physically downscaled (e.g. 2x2 is 32x24, 4x4 is
  16x12, odd-2x2 is 31x24 vs claimed 61x47) with no subsampling tag.
- `custom-refbw.tif`: no tag 532; same IFD/tags as 1x1; differs only in 9216
  pixel bytes — NOT byte-identical to 1x1 (SHA256 19078a9f... vs 70ffdf2e...;
  metadata identical, pixel data differs). The issue's "inaccurate test image"
  concern is about the false RefBW claim, not byte identity.
- `custom-coeffs.tif`: no tag 529 (BT.601 default implied).
- `cosited.tif`: no tag 531. `planar-2x2.tif`: PlanarConfig=1.
  `tiled-2x2.tif`: no tile tags, uses RowsPerStrip=24.

### Feasibility experiments (magick 7.1.2-35, /tmp/opencode)
- `-sampling-factor 2x2` does NOT write YCbCrSubSampling (stays [1,1]) and
  keeps full dimensions → subsampling NOT settable.
- `-define tiff:YCbCrPositioning=2`, `-set tiff:YCbCrPositioning 2`,
  `-define tiff:YCbCrCoefficients=...`, `-define tiff:ReferenceBlackWhite=...`,
  `-interlace Plane`, `-define tiff:planar-configuration=separate` — NONE set
  the respective tags.
- `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48` DOES write TileWidth=64/TileLength=48 and
  TileOffsets/TileByteCounts (no RowsPerStrip) → TILING IS settable and
  verified.

### Final decision
1. **Keep** `ycbcr-1x1.tif` (+ `.ppm`) unchanged — the only accurate fixture.
2. **Fix** the tiled case: regenerate at full 64x48 with
   `-define tiff:tile-geometry=64x48`, rename to `ycbcr-tiled.tif` (+
   `ycbcr-tiled.ppm`), relabel in the matrix as 1x1 / default / tiled. Tiling
   is the only variant attribute ImageMagick can truly set.
3. **Remove** the other 15 TIFFs and their 15 PPMs, documenting each reason:
   - subsampling not settable (`-resize` shrank images instead of tagging),
   - positioning / coefficients / ReferenceBlackWhite / planar not settable,
   - odd-dimension cases only valid together with real subsampling.
   Final fixture set = 2 images.
4. **Document** ImageMagick limitations in YCBCR_SUPPORT.md with verification
   results (what cannot be set; tiling can).
5. **Update** CHANGELOG.md count 17 → 2 and add a Fixed/Changed bullet.

---

## 4. Risks

- **RefBW formula accuracy:** must present the full, correct scaling equation.
  The conventional form maps code `C` to full-range `V` using reference black
  `Rblack` and reference white `Rwhite`:
  `V = (C - Rblack) * (MAX - MIN) / (Rwhite - Rblack) + MIN`, with defaults
  Y: 0/255, Cb/Cr: 128/255. Verify against the repo's forward/reverse formulas
  (H3 sections) and the TIFF 6.0 spec before finalizing, to avoid contradicting
  the library implementation.
- **No automated verification of tags in repo:** the audit relied on external
  ad-hoc tooling; ensure the regen command is re-run and re-verified after the
  final generator edit (the audit script `/tmp/opencode/tiffparse.py` is in
  temp storage, not the repo).
- **Generator still parses unused fields:** if any tuple fields remain, avoid
  leaving dead unpacking; align the CASES structure with what is actually
  emitted.
- **PPM/TIFF dimension mismatch:** ensure the kept/fixed PPMs match their TIFFs
  (both 64x48). The fixed tiled TIFF must be 64x48, not downscaled.
- **Test image count references:** confirm no other file (README, TEST_IMAGES,
  docs) states 17; research found none, but re-check after edits.
- **CI/build breakage:** low risk — no source/CI references fixtures — but run
  the standard validation anyway.

### Validation commands (no AGENTS.md in repo; CI runs the same three steps)
- Build: `./build.sh` (cmake --preset + cmake --build --preset, default
  preset `gcc-linux-release`)
- Test: `./run_test.sh` (ctest --preset ... --output-on-failure --rerun-failed)
- Fixture regen: `python3 tests/ycbcr_images/generate_ycbcr.py`

---

## 5. Docs impact

- `tests/YCBCR_SUPPORT.md`:
  - Rewrite "Reference black/white" H3 (lines 64–74) with full scaling formula
    and "code" terminology.
  - Add new H2 `## ImageMagick limitations` between "Generating the test
    images" (ends line 116) and "Test image matrix" (line 118).
  - Rebuild "Test image matrix" (lines 128–154) to 2 accurate rows:
    - `ycbcr-1x1.tif` — 64x48, subsampling 1x1, default coefficients,
      default ReferenceBlackWhite, centered positioning, chunky/contig,
      stripped. Ground-truth `ycbcr-1x1.ppm`.
    - `ycbcr-tiled.tif` — 64x48, subsampling 1x1, all defaults, tiled
      (TileWidth/Length 64x48). Ground-truth `ycbcr-tiled.ppm`.
  - Update "Generating the test images" to describe the regen command and the
    fact that only settable attributes are emitted.
  - Possibly trim "Minimum requirements"/other sections if they reference
    removed fixtures; verify no dangling file mentions.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: line 32 count 17 → 2; add a past-tense Fixed/Changed bullet
  summarizing the audit, fixture removals, tiled fix, and documentation
  improvements.
- No counts or fixture lists in `TEST_IMAGES.md` / `README.md` (verified) — no
  changes expected there, but confirm during implementation.
